title: Consider not normalizing form entries during construction of the entry list
body:
Currently, the ["construct the entry list"](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#constructing-the-form-data-set) algorithm performs a newline normalization on every entry coming from form-associated elements ([except for form-associated custom elements whose submission value is a list of entries](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/custom-elements.html#face-entry-construction)). These normalizations can be directly observed from the `FormData` constructor, when passed the corresponding `<form>` element.

In whatwg/url#562 I realized that this normalization didn't include a `File`'s filename, which needed to be normalized in the `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and `text/plain` enctypes but not in `multipart/form-data`. In #6247 we decided to also normalized entries which weren't normalized during the entry list construction, such as entries coming from FACEs and entries added in the `formdata` event. This lead to an additional normalization step during the enctype serializations that is being added in #6287. Since newline normalizations are idempotent, normalizing twice is unobservable from the form payload.

But the normalization in the "construct the entry list" algorithm as observed from the `FormData` constructor is only being implemented in Chromium – Firefox and Webkit defer it to the time when the form is serialized. And @annevk raised some concerns in #6247 about normalizing the entries twice. So it might be worth considering whether the spec should be changed to only perform the second normalization.
